source: PBJ-shaped synthetic dataset grounded in public staffing distributions

rules.label: Mandatory rest
rules.description: A nurse must have at least 10 hours between the end of one shift and the start of the next.

rules.label: Weekly hours cap
rules.description: No nurse may exceed 60 scheduled hours in a rolling week without triggering an agency backfill.

rules.label: Seniority bumping
rules.description: Senior staff can refuse mandatory overtime; junior staff are considered before agency.

rules.label: Skill coverage
rules.description: Cath lab coverage requires ACLS, ICU requires CCRN, and OR coverage requires a scrub/circulating-certified RN.
